create_ExtentTransform: create an ExtentTransform to extract and scale a subregion from a source image to a target output size
create_ResizeTransform: create a ResizeTransform to resize an image from its original dimensions to new height and width
create_RotationTransform: create a RotationTransform to rotate an image by a given number of degrees counter clockwise around its center
create_ColorTransform: create a ColorTransform to apply a callable photometric operation to an image without changing coordinates
create_PILColorTransform: create a PILColorTransform to apply a PIL photometric operation to a numpy array image
